notes: «سأل علي بن جعفر أخاه موسى بن جعفر»: the asker is a link, then the one asked, the Imam who answers (rule 5, owner ruling 2). «أخاه» with a name is one link (rule 7).
The blessing «عليهما السلام» is left out.
«سأل علي بن جعفر أخاه موسى بن جعفر»: the asker is a link, then the one asked, the Imam who answers (rule 5, owner ruling 2). «أخاه» with a name is one link (rule 7).
The blessing «عليهما السلام» is left out.

«وَ سَأَلَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ أَخَاهُ مُوسَى بْنَ جَعْفَرٍ» : the asker is a link, then the one asked, the Imam, as the last link (rule 5, owner ruling 2). «أخاه» is a relation word, not in the surface.
